en.summary: Hepatitis A is a liver infection spread via faecal–oral route. Symptoms: fever, flu-like illness, nausea, upper tummy pain, diarrhoea/constipation, pale stools, dark urine, itch, jaundice. NHS: see a GP if recent travel/exposure; urgent advice if pregnant, over 60, or known liver disease. Rest, fluids; infectious ~7 days after jaundice/symptom onset. Vaccination for risk groups is clinic-led — no invented vaccine schedules.
seeDoctorIf: You think you might have hepatitis A
Recent travel to a high-risk country
Pregnant, >60, or liver condition with suspected hep A — urgent advice
selfCare: Rest; fluids; limit contact while infectious as advised; hand hygiene after toilet
doNot: Do not invent antivirals or vaccine catch-up calendars
Do not share towels/food prep while infectious

fr.summary: L'hépatite A se transmet féco-orale. Fièvre, nausées, douleur haute, selles pâles, urines foncées, ictère. Avis médical ; urgent si grossesse, >60 ans, maladie du foie. Pas de schémas vaccinaux inventés.
seeDoctorIf: Voyage récent en zone à risque

he.summary: הפטיטיס A מועבר צואה-פה. חום, בחילה, כאב בטן עליון, צואה בהירה, שתן כהה, צהבת. ייעוץ; דחוף בהריון/>60/מחלת כבד. אין לוח חיסונים מומצא.

ru.summary: Гепатит A — фекально-оральный. Лихорадка, тошнота, боль вверху живота, светлый стул, тёмная моча, желтуха. К врачу; срочно при беременности/>60/болезни печени. Календари вакцин не выдумывать.
